content.name: Aditya Kulkarni
content.title: Head of Marketing
content.summary: Marketing head with 15 years in FMCG, consumer durables and home décor brands across India. Leads a 22-member team and a ₹38 crore annual budget at a decorative paints company, where a dealer-led tier-2 expansion lifted national market share by 2.1 points. Strong in brand building, trade marketing and regional-language campaigns.

experience.title: Head of Marketing
bullets: Lead brand, trade, digital and research for a decorative paints company with ₹1,450 crore revenue, managing 22 people and a ₹38 crore budget.
Designed a painter loyalty programme with UPI-linked rewards, enrolling 61,000 contractors and raising their repeat purchase rate by 27%.
Took the premium emulsion range into 140 tier-2 and tier-3 towns through dealer-shop branding and Marathi, Kannada and Telugu TV spots.
Rebalanced media from 70% television to 45%, shifting the rest to YouTube, OTT and regional influencers while holding reach and saving ₹4.6 crore.
Present the annual brand plan to the board and work with sales heads in four zones to set joint volume and visibility targets.

experience.title: Senior Brand Manager
bullets: Managed the ayurvedic personal care portfolio of 34 SKUs with annual sales of ₹310 crore.
Launched a herbal hair oil sub-brand in South India that reached ₹42 crore in its second year.
Built the company's first quick-commerce and e-commerce pack strategy, taking online share of sales from 6% to 19%.
Mentored three assistant brand managers, two of whom now lead categories.

experience.title: Brand Manager
bullets: Handled mixer grinders and water purifiers, coordinating launches with R&D, sales and the creative agency.
Ran a festive-season exchange offer across 2,300 dealer outlets that delivered 1.8 lakh units in eight weeks.
Commissioned consumer research in eight cities that shaped a lower-priced purifier variant for rental households.

experience.title: Management Trainee – Marketing
bullets: Rotated through sales, supply chain and brand teams before taking over the masala range in Maharashtra.
Planned village haat and mela activations in 120 locations, adding 9,000 new retail outlets.
Tracked monthly secondary sales by distributor and flagged slow movers, reducing near-expiry returns by ₹70 lakh a year.

education.school: Savitribai Phule Pune University (then University of Pune)

achievements.title: Market share gain
achievements.detail: National decorative paints share up 2.1 points in two years after the tier-2 expansion.

achievements.title: Sub-brand launch
achievements.detail: Herbal hair oil sub-brand crossed ₹42 crore annual sales in year two.
